articles.summary: This month we launched the Nullstone AI Skills Catalog, starting with a skill that guides IaC generation and validation. We also extended Deployment Monitoring to GCP Cloud Run, surfaced live Kubernetes failure states, and reworked the Capabilities and Infrastructure tabs. On the automation side, we shipped on-demand IaC sync, a set of reusable deployment GitHub Actions, and new deploy-time CLI controls — plus zero-downtime GKE rollouts and two new AWS app scaffolds. Read on for details.
articles.title: Changelog: June 2026
